rationale: Third party (neighbor's child) sustained bodily injury on policyholder's premises due to hazardous condition (icy walkway), which is a clear premises liability claim.
claim_summary: Premises liability claim: neighbor's 9-year-old daughter slipped on icy walkway in front of policyholder's home during ice storm last week and broke her wrist. Parents are discussing medical bills. High severity due to pediatric injury requiring careful handling.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.injury_description: broken wrist from slip and fall on ice
case_facts.description: third party child slipped on icy walkway and sustained broken wrist
